summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of Q1 2026 financial results and a $0.06 per share cash dividend declaration. The filing is a routine earnings report of a foreign private issuer, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or SPAC activity is described. The dividend is ordinary and does not represent a special capital return. The filing is incorporated by reference into an existing F-3 shelf registration statement.
